comparisons.name: forced-colors-light
comparisons.description: Forced colours (Windows high contrast) with a light system theme: the dot of an on button and the dash of a mixed one are drawn in the system's button text colour and so differ from an off button; disabled buttons use its grey text colour. The colours are the browser's emulated system colours, not Catalina's.

pixels.note: off: the centre is the canvas colour
on: the dot is ButtonText; before the fix it was the canvas colour, the same as off
on: the circle around the dot is the canvas colour, so the dot is a dot
mixed: the dash is ButtonText, 3 pt left of the centre where a dot would not reach
mixed: canvas above the dash, where a dot would be
disabled and off: the centre is the canvas colour
disabled and on: the dot is GrayText
